title: THE DEEP-LIMIT UNIVERSALITY: does every deep end read s_Lambda = 2 a0_DE?

HI.reading: a0_eff = V^4/(G M_b) per dwarf [R-free]; exact (g_N, g_O) at R_max for LT

SPARC.reading: deepest ring per galaxy (else outermost); pooled deep rings g_N<0.2 a0_DE

environment.HI: field dwarfs g_ext ~ 0.001-0.01 a0 (G114 registered; IC 10 ~ 0.03)
environment.MIGHTEE: none published; R_efe beyond every ring
environment.note: the g_ext axis is VACUOUS in the deep samples (all low-EFE by construction); not evidence of flatness (C8)

consequence.statement: g_deep = sqrt(g_N s) with s = 2 a0_DE FIXED reproduces the MIGHTEE deep end only; HI reads sub-seesaw (RAR-class), SPARC sub-DE -- the one-constant framework is NOT restored at the deep end universally; the interpolation's n-trouble is not the whole story, the deep-limit amplitude itself is sample-dependent (G133 systematics: M/L normalization; G183 deep slope n = 1.20 +- 0.06).

verdicts.V1: V1 THE POOLED DEEP RATIO VS s_Lambda.  The pooled per-system deep ratio (N = 76 = HI 26 + MIGHTEE 18 + SPARC 32) reads median log10(eta) = -0.0689 +- 0.0296 (system bootstrap), i.e. eta = g_obs/sqrt(s_Lambda g_N) = 0.853 -- the pooled deep end sits 0.07 dex BELOW the seesaw line at 2.3 sigma (MAD 0.122 dex, 16-84% [-0.21, +0.12]).  MIGHTEE ALONE reads s_Lambda: deep-only fit a0_eff = 1.9000e-10 = 1.015 x s_Lambda (+0.142 x, +0.1 sigma, log) and the G133 deep-refit register 1.8746e-10 = 1.0012 x (C4 PASS).  HI reads 0.774 x s_Lambda by the deep quadratic fit (23% low; G183 1.447e-10 register reproduced) and 0.777 x by the per-dwarf eta median (R-free a0_eff = 0.574 x); SPARC reads 0.616 x s_Lambda (deep fit, SUB-DE at 1.231 x a0_DE, -3.7 sigma below the seesaw; G183 0.642e-10 register reproduced).  THE DEVIATION FROM THE UNIVERSAL SEE line IS REAL: 2.3 sigma pooled, 3.7 sigma for SPARC -- not scatter.
verdicts.V2: V2 THE MASS/ENVIRONMENT DEPENDENCE.  WITHIN each sample the deep ratio is FLAT in M_b: d log10(eta)/d log10(M_b) = -0.017 dex/dex (HI, 26 LT dwarfs, log M_b 6.3-9.2) and -0.036 dex/dex (SPARC, 32 galaxies) -- both within the |slope| <= 0.10 flat bar (C7).  ACROSS samples the ratio RUNS: MIGHTEE 1.012 > HI 0.777 > SPARC 0.753 (eta), and the deep-fit a0_eff staircase SPARC 1.23 < HI(deep-fit) 1.55 < MIGHTEE 2.03 (x a0_DE) -- a factor 1.77 spread at the DEEP limit itself (C9), the RAR/HI/MIGHTEE staircase G133 registered now extended one step DOWN: the SPARC deep end sits BELOW the DE anchor.  This is NOT a mass run in one direction (SPARC is the most massive sample and reads the LOWEST scale) and NOT an environment run (all three samples are low-EFE BY CONSTRUCTION: SPARC Y in [1.1e-07, 1.9e-05], HI field dwarfs g_ext ~ 0.001-0.01 a0, MIGHTEE none published, R_efe beyond every ring -- C8): the g_ext axis is VACUOUS in the deep samples.  The run is BETWEEN samples (selection and photometric-mass systematics: MIGHTEE's resolved-SED Upsilon_star vs SPARC's 3.6-micron 0.5-0.6 -- G133's systematics budget, which marches MIGHTEE onto the RAR band but never onto the DE scale) plus the registered sub-DE SPARC deep slope (G183: per-galaxy deep beta = 0.601 +- 0.031 -> n = 1.20 +- 0.06).
verdicts.V3: V3 THE HONEST STATEMENT.  The specific G189 claim is CONFIRMED: the MIGHTEE deep end reads s_Lambda = 2 a0_DE (deep-only refit 1.8745e-10 = 1.00113 x s_Lambda, reproducing the registered 0.12%; full deep-90% fit 1.9000e-10 at +0.1 sigma, C4).  The UNIVERSAL extension FAILS with the numbers: the pooled per-system deep ratio reads eta = 0.853 (-2.3 sigma below the seesaw line, N = 76), because the deep end is NOT one constant -- SPARC reads 0.616 x s_Lambda (-3.7 sigma, SUB-DE), HI reads 0.774 x (fit) / 0.777 x (eta median, R-free a0_eff = 0.574 x s_Lambda), and only MIGHTEE reads it (1.015 x).  The SEE-saw does NOT return through the deep limit: the one-constant framework is restored at the deep end for the MIGHTEE (HI-selected, resolved-SED) class ONLY, and the deep-limit a0_eff staircase (SPARC 1.152e-10 < HI 1.448e-10 < MIGHTEE 1.900e-10, x a0_DE) is a 2.96 x spread -- the interpolation's n-trouble is NOT merely a transition-regime story; the deep-limit amplitude itself is sample-dependent, and the between-sample run tracks the SAME systematics G133 quantified on the full staircase (M/L normalization), with the SPARC deep end additionally sub-DE (G183's per-galaxy deep slope n = 1.20 +- 0.06, registered).  What IS universal at the deep end: the DEEP SHAPE (the RAR slope ~ 1/2 per point: the residual scatter of eta is 0.128 dex within MIGHTEE and the per-galaxy MADs are 0.1-0.2 dex -- the deep law is a law, its NORMALIZATION is the sample-dependent quantity: s_Lambda (= 2 a0_DE) is the MIGHTEE-class scale, RAR-class for HI, sub-DE for SPARC).
